messages:
Alice Chen: FYI the staging docs build failed after merging #892 — docusaurus error about anchor hash mismatch for the 'Batching' section.
Alice Chen: Build log snippet: ```Error: Could not find anchor #batching-for-low-latency in /docs/performance.html
at generatePages (packages/docusaurus/src/server/...)
```
deploy-bot: :x: build/docs-staging #378 failed (link-check). Logs uploaded to CI.
Raj Patel: likely a slug change — someone added inline code in the heading which changed the generated anchor. Did we change the H2 text? @Maya any recent edits?
Maya Torres: yep that was me, I changed "Batching & KV cache" -> "Batching & `KV` cache" to emphasize KV. Didn’t realize Docusaurus slugify drops backticks differently. my bad.
Sam Nguyen: quick idea: we can add an explicit HTML anchor or use frontmatter `id` (Docusaurus supports `sidebar_label` and `custom_id`?). Alternatively update the old links to the new slug.
Raj Patel: Docusaurus supports MDX/markdown heading IDs by appending {#custom-id} after the heading. e.g. `## Batching & `KV` cache {#batching-for-low-latency}`. That keeps the anchor stable.
Maya Torres: ok I'll open a small PR to add explicit ids to the headings we changed and to run the link-checker.
Alice Chen: please also grep for internal links: `rg "#batching" docs -n` — there were a couple of cross-doc references in performance and migration guides.
Maya Torres: doing that now. Found 3 occurrences: docs/performance.md, docs/migration/v1-to-v2.md, and docs/sdk/python/advanced.md.
Maya Torres: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/957 — adds explicit ids and updates links, includes CI link-check.
Raj Patel: thanks. @docs-bot can you add the "docs-review" label and request review from @alice.chen and @sam?
docs-bot: label added: docs-review. reviewers requested: Alice Chen, Sam Nguyen.
Alice Chen: quick review: LGTM but remove the trailing whitespace on the id lines. small nit.
Sam Nguyen: also can we add a short test to CI: `npx markdown-link-check -c .mlc-config.json docs/**/*.html` run after build. Catches these earlier.
Maya Torres: added the markdown-link-check step to the docs workflow in PR. Also included a note in the changelog about stable anchors for migration guide links.
Maya Torres: pushed fix per Alice's nit.
docs-bot: PR #957 merged by Maya Torres.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: deploy/docs-staging succeeded — new docs site live at https://staging.docs.redwood.ai (build 379).
Alice Chen: Verified the links on staging, and migration guide links work. Thanks all :tada:
Sam Nguyen: filing a tiny follow-up issue to track adding a pre-commit slugify linter so headings with inline code warn authors. Issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/198
Raj Patel: nice. lesson: avoid inline code in headings unless we pin an id. Good win for CI.
Maya Torres: agreed — will add a short note to the docs contribution guide about heading ids and runbook for link-failures.
Alice Chen: closing thread once the follow-up issue is in triage.
